title: The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, June 5, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, June 5, 2018 Posted by admin on June 5th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL), Intel (INTC), Microsoft (MSFT), Nike (NKE) and Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +8 points.
Monday the Dow was up +178.48 (+0.72%) at 24,813.69.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +0.38%.
There were 24 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by WAL-Mart (WMT) +2.93% and Merck (MRK) +2.41%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by General Electric (GE) -2.77% and Chevron (CVX)-1.28%.
Brent Crude futures are off 1.2% at $74.40 a barrel after the U.S. asked OPEC to increase production. It’s had little impact on WTI crude futures, the U.S. benchmark, which are off just 0.4% at $64.54 a barrel. The US has requested that OPEC raise output by 1M bbls/day which is weighing heavily on Brent crude prices this morning.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down seven-tenths of a cent at $2.942 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to report earnings in the near term.
